Jensen Huang love working with Elon data centers in space BG2

hook: Jensen Huang says he *loves working with Elon Musk*
caption:
NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang says he loves working with Elon Musk.

On the BG2 Pod, Huang said their engineering teams are designing a new server and computing architecture built to run both in space and on Earth. "One particular new market that we're going to go explore together is putting data centers out in space," he said.

Musk replied on X: "Old friends are the best friends. Jensen rocks."
